articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 Opus with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic has unveiled Claude 4 Opus, its most capable model to date, featuring a 2 million token context window and a new extended reasoning mode that allows the model to deliberate for up to 10 minutes before responding. The model reportedly outperforms all existing benchmarks on graduate-level science reasoning and complex multi-step coding tasks. Anthropic also announced a new constitutional AI update aimed at reducing subtle sycophancy observed in prior versions.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Human-Level Performance on MMMU-Pro
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 has reached human-expert-level performance on the MMMU-Pro multimodal benchmark, excelling at tasks combining visual charts, scientific diagrams, and natural language reasoning. The model also introduces native real-time video understanding at 60 frames per second, enabling new applications in robotics and live surveillance analysis. The update is rolling out to Gemini Advanced subscribers and enterprise API users starting this week.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches Operator Pro: Autonomous Agent Platform for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI has expanded its Operator product into a full enterprise platform called Operator Pro, enabling businesses to deploy autonomous AI agents that can manage multi-step workflows across CRM, ERP, and cloud infrastructure systems. The platform includes a new agent orchestration layer that allows chains of specialized sub-agents to collaborate on long-horizon tasks without human intervention. Early adopters including Salesforce and SAP report a 40% reduction in back-office processing time during the beta.

articles.title: Meta Releases LLaMA 4 Scout Open Weights Model, Rivals Proprietary Frontrunners
articles.summary: Meta has open-sourced LLaMA 4 Scout, a 109-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that Meta claims matches GPT-4o and Gemini 1.5 Pro on most standard benchmarks while remaining fully open-weight. The release includes fine-tuning recipes, safety classifiers, and a new retrieval-augmented generation toolkit designed to make enterprise RAG pipelines easier to build. The model is available immediately on Hugging Face and Meta's AI Studio portal.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Agency Issues First Major Fines to Three Tech Firms
articles.summary: The newly operational EU AI Office has issued its first enforcement actions under the AI Act, levying fines totaling €340 million against three unnamed technology companies for deploying high-risk AI systems without completing required conformity assessments. The fines mark a significant escalation in European AI regulation after months of soft guidance and voluntary compliance frameworks. Legal analysts expect the actions to trigger a wave of compliance reviews across the industry ahead of the 2027 full-enforcement deadline.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Publishes Study Showing RAG Pipelines Degrade with Long-Context LLMs
articles.summary: Researchers at Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute have released a paper demonstrating that retrieval-augmented generation systems show measurable performance degradation when paired with ultra-long-context models like Gemini Ultra 2.5 and Claude 4, due to attention dilution across retrieved chunks. The study suggests that current RAG architectures may need fundamental redesign as context windows exceed one million tokens. The authors propose a new hierarchical retrieval method called ContextAnchor that reduces this degradation by 38% in their experiments.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates Copilot Agents Directly into Windows 12 Kernel-Level APIs
articles.summary: Microsoft has announced that Windows 12's upcoming August update will expose kernel-level APIs allowing Copilot agents to interact directly with system processes, file I/O, and hardware sensors without sandboxing overhead. The move is intended to enable real-time AI assistance for power users and developers but has drawn immediate scrutiny from security researchers who warn of potential privilege escalation attack vectors. Microsoft says a new permission model called AgentGuard will require explicit user authorization for any sensitive system interaction.

articles.title: Mistral AI Unveils Mistral Large 3 with Native Tool Calling and Code Interpreter
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI has launched Mistral Large 3, featuring significantly improved native function calling, a built-in sandboxed code interpreter, and multilingual support expanded to 47 languages. The company claims the model achieves state-of-the-art results among open-API models on the BFCL tool-calling leaderboard, surpassing GPT-4o mini and Gemini Flash 2.0. Mistral Large 3 is available through the La Plateforme API and will be licensed under a new commercial-friendly Mistral Open License.
